name: Anonelio – Anonymous Forum Comments – 匿名掲示板風コメント
author: ikedajapan

sections.description:
Display standard WordPress comments as a simple Japanese anonymous-forum-style board directly below the main article body. The theme’s later comments template is suppressed to avoid duplication. On paginated articles the inline board appears on the final page. Pages retain the theme’s comments position. Includes numbered comments, >>number reply links, an optional name field, and optional pseudonymous IDs. A blank name uses the configured default (initially 名無し).

Published blog posts retain the comment board even when their existing comment settings are closed or WordPress would automatically close comments on older posts. This change applies while the plugin is active, without editing the stored settings. It does not force comments on pages, drafts, or password-protected posts.

The two-field board form intentionally allows comments without an email address, even when Discussion settings require a name and email. Login requirements, post visibility, passwords, moderation, duplicate detection, flood protection, and standard comment spam filters still apply. No CAPTCHA is included. Third-party CAPTCHA plugins may require integration with this custom form; their security checks are not disabled.

The language selected under Settings applies to the settings screen, save button, plugin-list description, and comment board. Automatic follows the WordPress site language on all these screens, even if the administrator has a different profile language. Bundled languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, and German. Untranslated strings fall back to English.

Works with themes that call the classic WordPress comments_template() function. Block themes using the Comments block are not currently supported. Existing comments remain stored as WordPress comments. Deleting the plugin does not delete comments or settings.

Privacy

No external service, telemetry, or tracking cookie is used by this plugin. Comments are stored in the site’s WordPress database, including WordPress’s standard IP address and user-agent fields. For logged-in submissions WordPress also stores the user ID. Public pseudonymous IDs are derived locally using a keyed hash of existing comment information and the post ID; IP addresses and email addresses are not displayed. IDs are pseudonyms, not a guarantee of anonymity; shared IP addresses can share an ID and IP changes can change it. Legacy pseudonym metadata is honored when present. Site owners should describe comment processing in their privacy policy.

日本語

WordPress標準のコメントを、レス番号・返信アンカー・匿名ID付きの掲示板風に表示します。投稿では本文のすぐ下に表示し、テーマ標準位置での二重表示を防ぎます。分割記事では最終ページの本文下に表示します。固定ページは従来のコメント位置を維持します。名前は任意入力で、空欄なら設定した匿名表示名になります。無料版です。

設定した表示言語は、設定画面・保存ボタン・プラグイン一覧の説明文・コメント欄すべてに適用されます。「自動」は管理者のプロフィール言語にかかわらず、WordPressのサイト言語に合わせます。

公開済みの通常記事では、過去記事のコメントが閉じられていても掲示板を表示して書き込みを受け付けます。WordPressの保存済みコメント設定は変更しません。固定ページ・下書き・パスワード保護記事は対象外です。

フォームは名前と本文の2項目です。メールアドレスは収集しません。ログイン必須設定、記事の公開範囲、パスワード、承認、スパム判定などは尊重します。CAPTCHAは内蔵していません。他のCAPTCHAプラグインとの連携は別途確認が必要です。

クラシック方式のコメントテンプレートを使うテーマ向けです。ブロックテーマのコメントブロックには未対応です。匿名IDは完全な匿名性を保証しません。WordPress標準のIPアドレス等はサイト内に保存されます。
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Settings > Anonelio – Anonymous Forum Comments – 匿名掲示板風コメント.
  3. Choose the default anonymous name, board language, and ID visibility.
  4. Open a post with comments enabled in a compatible classic theme.
sections.changelog:
0.1.2

  • Update the upgrade link label to Free Upgrade on the Plugins screen.
  • Link the plugin author name to the developer’s Patreon page.

0.1.1

  • Add an upgrade link to the Plugins screen.
  • Show the comment board on all published posts, including older posts with closed comments, without changing saved Discussion settings.

0.1.0

  • Initial release with localized UI, board comments, reply links, and standard WordPress moderation.
